idea-plugin.name: Send Code to Terminal
idea-plugin.description:
Send the current line or selected code directly to the active IDE terminal and execute it.

Works with single-line and multi-line selections while keeping focus in the editor.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Renamed the plugin to Send Code to Terminal.
  • Renamed the main action to Send Line/Selection to Terminal.

action.description: Send the current line or selection to the terminal
